subjectTemplate: An IFPA administrator has corrected something on {eventTitle}
bodyTemplate:
Hi {organizerName},

You organize {eventTitle} on footbag.org, and an IFPA administrator has corrected {whatChanged}. Nothing else about the event has changed.

Administrator's note:
{note}

You can see the event by logging in to footbag.org and opening it from your profile. If you believe this was corrected in error, submit a contact request from your profile edit page.
